newsitem.title: POLAND: WARTA LAUNCHES POLICY FOR TAX ADVISORS.
newsitem.headline: WARTA LAUNCHES POLICY FOR TAX ADVISORS.

text.p: Polish insurance company TUiR Warta SA has launched liability insurance for tax advisors and wants to keep expanding its portfolio of malpractice and other profession insurance, the company's official said on Friday.

"On March 30 we launched insurance for tax advisors... professional liability (insurance) is the smallest but also the fastest developing sector in liability insurance," director of the firm's liability department Wojciech Czapinski told a news conference.

He said professional insurance amounted to 15 percent of Warta's overall liability insurance portfolio. Liability insurance excluding motor liability accounted for 3.5 percent of Warta's insurance portfolio.
